answer: Public Claude Code and adjacent agent plugin marketplaces that publish workflow-shaped packs on this sweep: (1) anthropics/claude-plugins-official marketplace.json, 286 plugins, reconstructed schema green, declared $schema URL HTTP 404 so the index was not validated against a retrieved copy of its own schema document; every pack has license=UNDECLARED-IN-INDEX and last-release is a git pin or absent, not a calendar date. (2) anthropics/claude-plugins-community marketplace.json, 2282 plugins, same reconstructed schema, no $schema field at all, zero license/version fields. (3) Cline marketplace catalog.json, 202 entries (plugins/skills/mcps) with per-entry license fields on the index — the only Claude-adjacent catalog in this set that actually carries license on the index. (4) Official MCP registry /v0.1/servers page, 50 server versions this page, each row declares $schema server.schema.json (fetchable) plus registry _meta timestamps. (5) Smithery list page, 3 rows this page, index claims totalCount=10689. Continue hub DNS-failed; Cursor has no public JSON index fetched. Evidence B sample: index name '0x' vs plugin.json name '0x-ai' is CLAIM-NOT-RECEIPT; GitHub pack MCP requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN and was flagged, not installed; 42Crunch license Apache 2.0 is on plugin.json not on the official index. Bundled mcp.json is reported and was never auto-loaded. No marketplace package was installed.
